title: 447. Largest Divisible Subset

examples.explanation: 1 divides 2, giving a group of size 2; [1,3] is equally valid.
Each value divides the next, so the whole input is one valid group.

hints: Sort the numbers first; divisibility only needs checking on the sorted order.
Use dynamic programming where each entry extends the best chain ending at an earlier divisor.
Remember the predecessor of each choice so the longest chain can be rebuilt.
